mapper.insert: INSERT INTO credit_record (user_id, change_score, reason, action_type, credit_before, credit_after, credit_level, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{changeScore}, #{reason}, #{actionType}, #{creditBefore}, #{creditAfter}, #{creditLevel}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT credit FROM user WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET credit = #{credit} WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM credit_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
